questions.source: Education-News Consult 2023 BECE Social Studies Mock (Objective)

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: Which of the following is an activity that contributes to air pollution?
questions.explanation: Fumes from vehicles release harmful gases into the air and contribute to air pollution.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What is a potential health problem caused by air pollution?
questions.explanation: Air pollution can cause respiratory problems such as asthma.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)

questions.explanation: Planting more trees helps absorb carbon dioxide and prevent air pollution.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: Which of the following is an effective way to educate the community about reducing air pollution?
options: B. Doing a project on energy consumption
questions.explanation: Hosting a community event is an effective way to educate the public about reducing air pollution.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: Which countries are mentioned as examples for global energy sources and conservation?
questions.explanation: Ghana, the United Kingdom and Germany are cited as examples in discussing global energy sources and conservation.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What is the purpose of researching alternative energy sources using the Internet?
options: C. Save money on energy bills

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: How do gender issues relate to energy production and usage?
options: B. Access to energy affects quality of life differently for various genders

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What is the role of measuring devices in energy consumption?
options: B. Track and control energy usage

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What are natural resources?

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)

questions.explanation: Gold is a non-renewable resource because it cannot be replenished once extracted.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: On the map of Ghana, where would you show the location of natural resources?

questions.question: What is the difficulty in effectively exploiting natural resources?

questions.explanation: Limited technology, expertise and capital resources hinder the effective exploitation of natural resources.

questions.question: Explain the importance of natural resources for the development of the country.
options: A. Natural resources are irrelevant for development
B. Natural resources contribute to economic growth and development

questions.explanation: Natural resources contribute to economic growth and development through revenue and employment.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: In the context of social security and pension schemes, what does "employer" refer to?
options: B. An organization or person providing employment
questions.explanation: An employer is the organization or person that provides employment to workers.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What are the obligations of an employer in social security and pension schemes?
options: A. Not required to register employees
B. Registering employees and paying contributions regularly

questions.explanation: An employer must register employees and pay their social security and pension contributions regularly.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: In groups, what should employees discuss regarding social security and pension schemes?
options: C. Avoiding discussions on employee benefits
questions.explanation: Employees should discuss and update their contribution records regularly regarding social security.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: What is the importance of tourism to the socio-economic development of Ghana?
options: A. Tourism has no impact on development

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)
questions.question: How can tourist sites be improved?

questions.question: Why is it important to discuss gender issues related to energy production, supply, and usage?
options: A. Gender has no impact on energy choices

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Objective Questions (Set 1)

questions.question: What is a possible disadvantage of using non-renewable energy sources?

B. It is a key agent of socialisation and support
C. It determines an individual's career path
D. It has no role beyond providing shelter
questions.explanation: The family is a key agent of socialisation and support in society.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: The intention to reduce the negative consequences of conflicts through theories and methods is termed as .........
questions.explanation: Conflict management is the set of theories and methods used to reduce the negative consequences of conflicts.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: All the following are outcomes of volunteerism except .........
questions.explanation: Gaining financial reward is not an outcome of volunteerism, since volunteering is unpaid.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: Which of the following is described as the period of prolonged water shortage?
questions.explanation: A drought is a period of prolonged water shortage.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: Which type of climatic zone lies between the forest and the Savannah area?
questions.explanation: The transition zone lies between the forest and the savannah areas.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: In which climate zones do the forests lose their leaves at various periods of the year?
questions.explanation: Deciduous forests lose their leaves at various times of the year.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 1 (Objective)
questions.question: Demand drives ............. when consumers use less energy.
questions.explanation: When consumers use less energy, demand falls and prices are driven down.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: One of the physical changes that occur in the male adolescent is the maturation of .........
questions.explanation: During adolescence, the male reproductive or productive organs mature.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Stress and strain are characteristics of the adolescent period because generally
options: A. Adolescents are expected to produce anything without many difficulties
B. Adolescents want to behave like adults
C. Adolescence is associated with marriage
D. Adolescence is associated with puberty
questions.explanation: Adolescents experience stress and strain because they want to behave like adults.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The period of adolescence is characterized by .....
options: A. A feeling of low self-esteem
B. Moving from childhood to adulthood
C. Ability to take good care of the body
questions.explanation: Adolescence is the period of moving from childhood to adulthood.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: When adolescents are ignorant about their reproductive health it leads to .....
questions.explanation: Ignorance about reproductive health can lead to irresponsible sexual relationships.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: One of the following practices does not promote a healthy living.
questions.explanation: A life insurance policy does not promote healthy living; regular exercise, good diet and sanitation do.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The Ghanaian traditional belief which undermines the stability of the family and society and impedes national development is the belief in
questions.explanation: Belief in witchcraft undermines family and society stability and impedes national development.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: One of the following cultural elements does not bind members of a family together
questions.explanation: Occupation does not bind family members together; marriage, funerals and festivals do.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The best way of promoting national identity in Ghana is through
options: A. The institution of a common dietary system
B. Adoption of a common national language
questions.explanation: Adopting a common national language is the best way to promote national identity in Ghana.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Misunderstandings in the Ghanaian traditional society are best addressed by
questions.explanation: Legal and moral codes best address misunderstandings in traditional Ghanaian society.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The existence of conflict is indicated by one of the following
questions.explanation: A quarrel is an indication that conflict exists.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which of the following is not an effect of interpersonal conflict?
options: A. Interruption of good relations between family members
questions.explanation: Interpersonal conflict does not increase team spirit; it interrupts relations and causes stress.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: A major reason why the natural resources of Ghana have not been sufficiently exploited is
options: D. Small market for finished goods
questions.explanation: Low technical know-how is a major reason Ghana's natural resources are not sufficiently exploited.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Human resources are not properly utilized in Ghana mainly because of
questions.explanation: Inadequate manpower development is the main reason human resources are not properly utilized in Ghana.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Labour is said to be skilled when it
options: B. Performs its work with longer hours
C. Acquires more hands for work
D. Uses more physical than mental ability
questions.explanation: Labour is skilled when the worker has gone through formal training.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: A resource is classified as renewable when it can be
options: A. Replenished before it runs out
questions.explanation: A renewable resource is one that can be replenished before it runs out.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which of the following are not non-renewable natural resources?
questions.explanation: Trees are renewable because they can be replanted, unlike gold, gas and oil.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: To ensure efficient use of Ghana's human resources, those in authority must
options: A. Contract more world bank loans for community projects
B. Employ many people as civil servants
C. Appoint only members of the ruling party to high positions
D. Appoint qualified people to occupy job positions
questions.explanation: Appointing qualified people to job positions ensures the efficient use of human resources.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What is a map?
options: B. A representation of an area
questions.explanation: A map is a representation of an area.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which of the following is a component of maps that represents direction?
questions.explanation: The north arrow on a map represents direction.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Why are maps important for airline managers?
questions.explanation: Airline managers use maps to plan flight routes.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What does a map key on a physical map represent?
questions.explanation: On a physical map, the map key represents physical features.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: When sketching a map, what should be used to represent settlements and industrial developments?
questions.explanation: Lines and symbols are used on maps to represent settlements and industrial developments.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: In mapping, what is the purpose of a scale?
questions.explanation: A map scale is used to measure distances on the map.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What is the main purpose of locating landmarks using maps?
options: A. To navigate in a city
questions.explanation: Landmarks are located using maps mainly for navigation in a city.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which of the following is a hot desert?
questions.explanation: The Sahara is a hot desert.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Identify the ocean located to the west of Africa.
questions.explanation: The Atlantic Ocean is located to the west of Africa.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What major physical feature is the Amazon Rainforest an example of?
questions.explanation: The Amazon Rainforest is an example of a rainforest.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which river is not located in Africa?
questions.explanation: The Mississippi River is in North America, not Africa.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Discussing human activities affecting rivers involves:
questions.explanation: Deforestation and pollution are human activities that affect rivers.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What is the role of the Ghana Meteorological Agency (GMA)?
questions.explanation: The Ghana Meteorological Agency (GMA) is responsible for weather forecasting.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which is a human-made natural disaster?
questions.explanation: Floods are often caused or worsened by human activities such as poor drainage, making them human-made disasters.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Suggesting ways to manage disasters includes:
questions.explanation: Implementing evacuation plans is a key way to manage disasters.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Dams in Ghana are used for...
questions.explanation: Dams in Ghana, such as the Akosombo Dam, are used for energy generation.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Discussing strengths and weaknesses with peers helps in:
questions.explanation: Discussing strengths and weaknesses with peers helps build self-awareness.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What is the Watson Commission known for?
questions.explanation: The Watson Commission's findings accelerated Ghana's march to independence.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What was the significance of the 28th February riots in Accra?
questions.explanation: The 28th February 1948 riots were a call for independence in the Gold Coast.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: Which organization is responsible for the early detection of natural disasters in Ghana?
questions.explanation: The Ghana Meteorological Agency (GMA) is responsible for the early detection of natural disasters in Ghana.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: What impact did the visit to the spot where ex-servicemen were killed have on the push for independence?
options: A. It fuelled a renewed determination for self-rule
B. It strengthened loyalty to the colonial authorities
C. It deepened divisions among nationalist leaders
questions.explanation: The visit fuelled a renewed determination for self-rule and independence.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The first agency of socialization is ..
questions.explanation: The family is the first agency of socialisation.

questions.source: Education-News Consult 2024 BECE Social Studies Mock 2 (Objective)
questions.question: The First Prime Minister of Ghana was..
questions.explanation: Dr. Kwame Nkrumah was the first Prime Minister of Ghana.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The land was acquired by the early colonial administrators for the establishment of
options: B. trading posts for the Europeans
questions.explanation: Early colonial administrators acquired land chiefly to build schools and health institutions to support administration.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The basic function of the human right commission in Ghana is to
options: B. punish offenders who abuse rights
C. hear and settle political cases
D. prevent citizens from voting wrongly
questions.explanation: The Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ) investigates allegations of human rights abuses.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Which resource is abundant in Ghana due to its location within the tropics?
questions.explanation: Ghana's location within the tropics gives it abundant sunshine (solar energy).

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: African Unity was the central theme of Ghana's foreign policy under
questions.explanation: African unity (Pan-Africanism) was the central theme of Nkrumah's foreign policy and helped found the OAU.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: A nation can be identified by all the following factors except
questions.explanation: A nation is identified by sovereignty, independence, a defined territory and common culture — 'equality' is not a defining factor.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Which of the following problems is likely to arise if a government does not ensure the proper development of the country's natural resources?
questions.explanation: Poor resource development reduces jobs and employment opportunities for the people.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Which of the following activities is an example of preserving and promoting Ghanaian culture?
options: A. Promoting the use of foreign products
questions.explanation: Learning a Ghanaian language helps preserve and promote our culture.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The practice whereby soldiers take over the government of a country is known as
questions.explanation: A coup d'état is the sudden forcible takeover of government by the military or a small group.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The concept of sustainable development mainly focuses on
options: A. exploiting the available resources for the present
B. managing resources for both present and future generations
C. protecting the environment for future generations
D. developing more natural resources for all
questions.explanation: Sustainable development meets present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The society can become peaceful if the citizens
options: A. resist the law enforcement agencies
B. obey the laws of the land
C. pay their taxes to the state
questions.explanation: Peace is maintained when citizens obey the laws of the land.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: A citizen's obligation to the state demands that the citizen should
options: A. enjoy the rights of the state
B. enjoy freedom of the state
C. serve the interest of the state
questions.explanation: A citizen's obligations/duties require serving the interest of the state (e.g. paying taxes, national service).

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: A person who moves from one place to another by crossing international borders is
questions.explanation: A migrant is someone who moves from one place to another, especially across borders.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: One major factor that can influence the teenage child's behaviour negatively is
questions.explanation: Peer pressure can negatively influence teenage behaviour.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The general rule that has the force of law because it has been accepted by the people for a long time is called
questions.explanation: A custom is a long-accepted practice that has gained the force of law over time.

questions.source: BECE 2021 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Ghana aims at achieving efficient and productive labour force through
questions.explanation: A well-educated and skilled labour force makes workers more efficient and productive.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Culture is dynamic because it
options: A. can be transferred or passed on from one generation to the next
B. is accepted by all people in the society
C. changes from time to time to meet the needs of the society
D. includes the way of life of the people
questions.explanation: A dynamic culture is one that changes over time to meet the changing needs of society.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The chiefs and elders are traditional authorities of the state because they
options: D. are custodians of the customs and traditions
questions.explanation: Chiefs and elders are traditional authorities because they are custodians of the customs and traditions of the people.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The Trans-Saharan Trade was a trade between
options: A. North Africa and West Africa
B. North Africa and Central Africa
C. North Africa and East Africa
D. West Africa and Southern Africa
questions.explanation: The Trans-Saharan Trade linked North Africa and West Africa across the Sahara Desert.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The main problem affecting the environment in the savannah zone of Ghana is
questions.explanation: Bush burning (annual fires) is the main environmental problem in the savannah zone.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The wage and salary in Ghana is paid in the form of
questions.explanation: Wages and salaries in Ghana are paid in money (cash) form.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The three main types of land ownership in Ghana are
questions.explanation: Land in Ghana is owned under family (lineage), communal (stool/skin) and state ownership.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Drug abuse among the youth can lead to the following except
questions.explanation: Drug abuse harms health; it cannot lead to good health.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Which of the following is a major cause of road accidents on Ghana's roads?
options: D. Use of proper road signs
questions.explanation: Poor/bad road conditions are a major cause of road accidents in Ghana.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Ghana adopted the concept of decentralisation to promote
questions.explanation: Decentralisation brings government closer to the people, promoting participatory good governance.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The first step in the problem-solving process is
questions.explanation: The problem-solving process begins with identifying the problem.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: One way through which the Ghana Police Service protects the right of citizens is by
options: A. arresting and detection of offenders
B. organizing seminars for the public
D. directing traffic on our roads
questions.explanation: By arresting and detecting offenders the police protect citizens' rights and property.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: A community is said to be healthy when
options: A. all inhabitants are treated for diseases
B. there is peaceful co-existence among the people
C. it has water and a well-planned environment
D. there are no disease-causing vectors
questions.explanation: A healthy community has good water supply and a clean, well-planned environment.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Self-employment is very important in Ghana because it
options: B. reduces the rate of migration
questions.explanation: Self-employment creates jobs and income for individuals, reducing unemployment.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: The main disadvantage of using the one-party system of government is that it
options: A. prevents the ruler from staying in power for long
B. suppresses freedom and freedom of speech
C. allows different parties to rule
questions.explanation: One-party systems suppress opposition and freedom of speech.

questions.source: BECE 2022 Social Studies Paper 1 (WAEC/GES)
questions.question: Bank of Ghana is the bank that
options: A. prints new currency for the government
B. lends money to the public
C. keeps records on government revenue
questions.explanation: The Bank of Ghana issues/prints the national currency and manages it on behalf of the government.
